summary: Private productivity tools, app profiles, and steadier suggestions.

changes.title: Undo and redo verified edits
changes.detail: A short editor-local journal supports undo and redo of confirmed delete swipes and selected-text edits, with existing host fallback.

changes.title: Smart clipboard extraction
changes.detail: Tap the Clipboard · Extract header to choose a masked link, email, phone or verification code from the current plain-text clip. Sensitive or oversized clips are excluded from automatic history and previews.

changes.title: Per-app profiles
changes.detail: BR Brain offers app-specific correction, suggestions, number row, sound, haptics and always-private settings.

changes.title: Text tools
changes.detail: Select plain text, then open Text tools in the toolbar for local case, whitespace and line transformations.

changes.title: Stable suggestions
changes.detail: Unrelated suggestion replacements no longer crossfade full words; session recall is never retained as outgoing artwork.
